title: GitHub Actions and Pages are experiencing degraded availability
summary: GitHub experienced a service degradation affecting GitHub Actions (CI/CD pipelines) and GitHub Pages (static site hosting), causing significant disruption to developer workflows and public-facing websites. The incident generated substantial community attention with 395 points and 315 comments on Hacker News.
problem_solved: This is an incident report documenting a service outage rather than a solution; it provides transparency about GitHub's infrastructure problems affecting thousands of developers.
why_valuable: The incident highlights the dependency of modern software development on cloud infrastructure and the cascading impact when major platforms experience downtime.
